arxiv-1902-05413.description: Abstract . Yelp has been one of the most popular local service search engine in US since 2004. It is powered by crowd-sourced text reviews and photo reviews. Restaurant customers and business owners upload photo images to Yelp, including reviewing or advertising either food, drinks, or inside and outside decorations. 1 1 1 Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.

arxiv-1906-07547.title: A Comprehensive Self-interference Model for Single-antenna Full-duplex Communication Systems
arxiv-1906-07547.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by . Single-antenna full-duplex communication technology has the potential to substantially increase spectral efficiency. However, limited propagation domain cancellation of single-antenna system results in a higher impact of receiver chain nonlinearities on the residual self-interference (SI) signal. In this paper, we offer a comprehensive SI model for single-antenna full-duplex systems based on direct-conversion transceiver structure considering nonlinearities of all the transceiver radio frequency (RF) components, in-phase/quadrature (IQ) imbalances, phase noise effect, and receiver noise figure.

arxiv-2012-10360.creator: Weiwen Jiang, Jinjun Xiong, Yiyu Shi
arxiv-2012-10360.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Weiwen Jiang, Jinjun Xiong, Yiyu Shi. Along with the development of AI democratization, the machine learning approach, in particular neural networks, has been applied to wide-range applications. In different application scenarios, the neural network will be accelerated on the tailored computing platform. The acceleration of neural networks on classical computing platforms, such as CPU, GPU, FPGA, ASIC, has been widely studied; however, when the scale of the application consistently grows up, the memory bottleneck becomes obvious, widely known as memory-wall.

arxiv-2304-11071.title: Improved effective potential of Gildener-Weinberg models
arxiv-2304-11071.creator: Huan Souza, L. H. S. Ribeiro, A. C. Lehum
arxiv-2304-11071.description: Abstract The Gildener-Weinberg models are of particular interest in the context of extensions to the Standard Model of particle physics. These extensions may encompass a variety of theories, including double Higgs models, grand unification theories, and proposals for dark matter, among others. In order to rigorously test these models experimentally, obtaining precise results is of crucial importance.

arxiv-2305-00519.title: Planar graphs as distinguished graph of Morse flows on the 2-disk
arxiv-2305-00519.creator: Oleksandr Pryshliak
arxiv-2305-00519.description: Abstract To investigate the topological structure of Morse flows on the 2-disk we use the planar graphs as destinguished graph of the flow. We assume, that the flow is transversal to the boundary of the 2-disk. We give a list of all planar graph with at least 3 edges and describe all planar graphs with 4 edges.

arxiv-2306-13318.title: Micromechanical field-effect transistor terahertz detectors with optical interferometric readout
arxiv-2306-13318.creator: V. Ryzhii 1 , C. Tang 1,2 , T. Otsuji 1 , M. Ryzhii 3 , S. G. Kalenkov 4 , V. Mitin 5 , and M. S. Shur 6
arxiv-2306-13318.description: Abstract We investigate the response of the micromechanical field-effect transistors (MMFETs) to the impinging terahertz (THz) signals. The MMFET uses the microcantilevers MC as a mechanically floating gate and the movable mirror of the Michelson optical interferometer. The MC mechanical oscillations are transformed into optical signals and the MMFET operates as the detector of THz radiation with the optical output.

arxiv-2310-01316.title: Entanglement of Nanophotonic Quantum Memory Nodes in a Telecom Network
arxiv-2310-01316.creator: C. M. Knaut, A. Suleymanzade, Y.-C. Wei, D. R. Assumpcao, P. -J. Stas, Y. Q. Huan, B. Machielse, E. N. Knall, M. Sutula, G. Baranes, N. Sinclair, C. De-Eknamkul, D. S. Levonian, M. K. Bhaskar, H. Park, M. Lončar, M. D. Lukin
arxiv-2310-01316.description: Abstract A key challenge in realizing practical quantum networks for long-distance quantum communication involves robust entanglement between quantum memory nodes connected via fiber optical infrastructure 1 ; 2 ; 3 . Here, we demonstrate a two-node quantum network composed of multi-qubit registers based on silicon-vacancy (SiV) centers in nanophotonic diamond cavities integrated with a telecommunication (telecom) fiber network.

arxiv-2405-07553.title: Space Domain based Ecological Cooperative and Adaptive Cruise Control on Rolling Terrain
arxiv-2405-07553.creator: Mingyue Lei, Haoran Wang, Lu Xiong, Jaehyun (Jason) So, Ashish Dhamaniya, Jia Hu
arxiv-2405-07553.description: Abstract Cooperative and Adaptive Cruise Control (CACC) is widely focused to enhance driving fuel-efficiency by maintaining a close following gap. The ecology of CACC could be further enhanced by adapting to the rolling terrain. However, current studies cannot ensure both planning optimality and computational efficiency. Firstly, current studies are mostly formulated on the conventional time domain.

arxiv-2407-03025.title: XMM-Newton and NuSTAR discovery of a likely IP candidate XMMU J173029.8–330920 in the Galactic Disk
arxiv-2407-03025.creator: Samaresh Mondal, Gabriele Ponti, Luke Filor, Tong Bao, Frank Haberl, Ciro Salcedo, Sergio Campana, Charles J. Hailey, Kaya Mori, and Nanda Rea
arxiv-2407-03025.description: Abstract Aims. We aim at characterizing the population of low-luminosity X-ray sources in the Galactic plane by studying their X-ray spectra and periodic signals in the light curves. Methods. We are performing an X-ray survey of the Galactic disk using XMM-Newton , and the source XMMU J173029.8–330920 was serendipitously discovered in our campaign.

arxiv-2503-17821.title: OvercookedV2: Rethinking Overcooked for Zero-Shot Coordination
arxiv-2503-17821.creator: Tobias Gessler Tin Dizdarevic
arxiv-2503-17821.description: Abstract AI agents hold the potential to transform everyday life by helping humans achieve their goals. To do this successfully, agents need to be able to coordinate with novel partners without prior interaction, a setting known as zero-shot coordination (ZSC). Overcooked has become one of the most popular benchmarks for evaluating coordination capabilities of AI agents and learning algorithms.

arxiv-2504-08596.title: MedHal: An Evaluation Dataset for Medical Hallucination Detection
arxiv-2504-08596.creator: Gaya Mehenni, Amal Zouaq
arxiv-2504-08596.description: Abstract We present MedHal, a novel large-scale dataset specifically designed to evaluate if models can detect hallucinations in medical texts. Current hallucination detection methods face significant limitations when applied to specialized domains like medicine, where they can have disastrous consequences.

arxiv-2505-10839.title: Alexandria: A Library of Pluralistic Values for Realtime Re-Ranking of Social Media Feeds
arxiv-2505-10839.creator: Akaash Kolluri, Renn Su, Farnaz Jahanbakhsh, Dora Zhao, Tiziano Piccardi, Michael S. Bernstein
arxiv-2505-10839.description: Abstract Social media feed ranking algorithms fail when they too narrowly focus on engagement as their objective. The literature has asserted a wide variety of values that these algorithms should account for as well—ranging from well-being to productive discourse—far more than can be encapsulated by a single topic or theory.

pmc-11342599.creator: Jialin Lu, Yuqing Ma, Qiuxin Li, Yihuan Xu, Yiquan Xue, Sheng Xu
pmc-11342599.description: With the advent of adoptive cellular therapy, chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-T cell therapy has gained widespread application in cancer treatment and has demonstrated significant efficacy against certain hematologic malignancies. However, due to the limitations of CAR-T cell therapy in treating solid tumors, other immune cells are being modified with CAR to address this issue.

pmc-11482248.title: Bronchial cell epigenetic aging in a human experimental study of short-term diesel and ozone exposures
pmc-11482248.creator: Jamaji C Nwanaji-Enwerem, Anne K Bozack, Cavin Ward-Caviness, David Diaz-Sanchez, Robert B Devlin, Marie‐Abèle C Bind, Andres Cardenas
pmc-11482248.description: Blood-based, observational, and cross-sectional epidemiological studies suggest that air pollutant exposures alter biological aging. In a single-blinded randomized crossover human experiment of 17 volunteers, we examined the effect of randomized 2-h controlled air pollution exposures on respiratory tissue epigenetic aging.

pmc-12469073.title: Quantum Information Supports Delayed Decisions
pmc-12469073.creator: Marius Nagy, Naya Nagy
pmc-12469073.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Chatbots, search engines and Database Query Systems are invaluable sources of information for decision-making processes in the data-driven world in which we live today. In this study, we explore the extent to which classical and Quantum Query Systems can support future decisions, taken at a moment where the query service may be inaccessible and the decision has to be based solely on information collected in the past.

pmc-12779161.title: Coancestry superposed on admixed populations yields measures of relatedness at individual-level resolution
pmc-12779161.creator: Danfeng Chen, John D. Storey
pmc-12779161.description: The admixture model is widely applied to estimate and interpret population structure among individuals. Here we consider a “standard admixture” model that assumes the admixed populations are unrelated and also a generalized model, where the admixed populations themselves are related via coancestry (or covariance) of allele frequencies.
